verdict.rationale: The IRS is a sovereign government tax authority whose filing rails (MeF, IRIS, the EIN assistant) are inherently authority-operated. Self-hosting the 'core product' is a category error for this kind of entity, not an unmet capability. Nothing in the evidence shows any self-hostable distribution; the ATS test environment is IRS-hosted and registration-gated, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
